opening.argument: The presentation solicits paid participation through a $99 lifetime membership and mining-pool purchases, with displayed prices, “Buy Now” buttons, 600-day mining terms, and commission or repurchase language. The speaker says the opportunity will provide “a 50%, 60%, or 70% profit share,” while also offering percentage payments for sharing contracts, including “six percent of whatever they buy.” It further promotes immediate income by stating, “if you need money by the end of the night go out and sell a contract we'll pay you the same day.” The displayed daily Bitcoin earnings reach $2,000, and the speaker says viewers “could make 800 to 2000 per day.” These projected prices, mining returns, and payment claims are not verified.
